metadata.description: Red tiles form a kalyna branch with clustered berries and paired leaves. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Twin flank corridors surround the motif, with sparse archipelago along the lower route. 3 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
